zoe: Quick sync  We need a compact newsletter + pre-launch drip for the upcoming benchmark blog & webinar. Goal: convert active readers to registrants and route hot leads. Three segments: active, warm, dormant.

kyle: Agree. Active = opens/clicks last 21d (hard invite + 48h reminder). Warm = opens 2260d (teaser then invite). Dormant = >60d (education lead gen, no hard ask).

rachel: I'll own copy. Tone: clear, data-first, 1 CTA. Will draft 2 subject variants per segment.

mike: Ops checklist: build segments in Customer.io, suppress registered/unsubscribed, seed list, Litmus QA, add utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=bench-launch. Also prepare tag mapping: bench_lead_hot / bench_lead_cold.

kyle: Test plan: A/B subject on 10% holdout; winner auto-sends after 24h. Send windows: Tue/Thu 10am local for Active/Warm, Fri 11am for Dormant.

rachel: Draft subjects (quick): Active: "Live: benchmark + real numbers" / "Benchmark reveal  save your seat"; Warm: "Sneak peek: benchmark takeaways" / "Worth 20 mins: benchmark highlights"; Dormant: "Beginners guide to inference cost" / "How teams cut latency & cost"

mike: Automation: on register -> tag + push to CRM as MQL; no-register after two sends -> move to evergreen benchmark drip.

zoe: Owners: Rachel copy by Mon 9am PT, Mike build & schedule, Kyle routing & CRM mapping. I'll QA & approve. Keep progress here. :white_check_mark:
